about.description:
ccache-storage-redis is a ccache remote storage helper for Redis,
implemented in Go. ccache invokes it for redis://, rediss://, and
redis+unix: URLs.

tests.script:
bin_dir="$(dirname "$(command -v ccache-storage-redis)")"
test "$(readlink "$bin_dir/ccache-storage-rediss")" = "ccache-storage-redis"
test "$(readlink "$bin_dir/ccache-storage-redis+unix")" = "ccache-storage-redis"
for bin in ccache-storage-redis ccache-storage-rediss 'ccache-storage-redis+unix'; do
  status=0
  output=$("$bin" 2>&1) || status=$?
  test "$status" -eq 1
  printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -q "ccache Redis storage helper"
  printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -q "Version: ${{ version }}"
done

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.2.1"

package:
  name: ccache-storage-redis
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/ccache/ccache-storage-redis/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 56cd23972860ba2caa17efffcff31dc9a327cfd717217ab680cac8e94871c006
  target_directory: src

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - cd src
    - go-licenses save . --save_path ../library_licenses
    - if: unix
      then:
        - go build -v -o $PREFIX/bin/ccache-storage-redis -ldflags="-s -w" .
        - ln -s ccache-storage-redis $PREFIX/bin/ccache-storage-rediss
        - ln -s ccache-storage-redis "$PREFIX/bin/ccache-storage-redis+unix"
      else:
        - go build -v -o %LIBRARY_BIN%\ccache-storage-redis.exe -ldflags="-s" .
        - copy /Y %LIBRARY_BIN%\ccache-storage-redis.exe %LIBRARY_BIN%\ccache-storage-rediss.exe
        # cmd.exe `copy` treats "+" as concatenation, so copy this name with PowerShell.
        - powershell -NoProfile -Command "Copy-Item -LiteralPath ($env:LIBRARY_BIN + '\ccache-storage-redis.exe') -Destination ($env:LIBRARY_BIN + '\ccache-storage-redis+unix.exe') -Force"

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("go-nocgo") }}
    - go-licenses

tests:
  - package_contents:
      bin:
        - ccache-storage-redis
        - ccache-storage-rediss
        - ccache-storage-redis+unix
      strict: true
  - script:
      - if: unix
        then:
          # Without CRSH_IPC_ENDPOINT and CRSH_URL the helper prints usage and exits 1.
          - |
            bin_dir="$(dirname "$(command -v ccache-storage-redis)")"
            test "$(readlink "$bin_dir/ccache-storage-rediss")" = "ccache-storage-redis"
            test "$(readlink "$bin_dir/ccache-storage-redis+unix")" = "ccache-storage-redis"
            for bin in ccache-storage-redis ccache-storage-rediss 'ccache-storage-redis+unix'; do
              status=0
              output=$("$bin" 2>&1) || status=$?
              test "$status" -eq 1
              printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -q "ccache Redis storage helper"
              printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -q "Version: ${{ version }}"
            done
        else:
          - |
            call :check "%CONDA_PREFIX%\Library\bin\ccache-storage-redis.exe"
            if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
            call :check "%CONDA_PREFIX%\Library\bin\ccache-storage-rediss.exe"
            if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
            call :check "%CONDA_PREFIX%\Library\bin\ccache-storage-redis+unix.exe"
            if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
            fc /b "%CONDA_PREFIX%\Library\bin\ccache-storage-redis.exe" "%CONDA_PREFIX%\Library\bin\ccache-storage-rediss.exe" >nul
            if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
            fc /b "%CONDA_PREFIX%\Library\bin\ccache-storage-redis.exe" "%CONDA_PREFIX%\Library\bin\ccache-storage-redis+unix.exe" >nul
            if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
            exit /b 0
            :check
            "%~1" > "%TEMP%\crsh-out.txt" 2>&1
            if not "%ERRORLEVEL%"=="1" exit /b 1
            findstr /C:"ccache Redis storage helper" "%TEMP%\crsh-out.txt" >nul
            if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
            findstr /C:"Version: ${{ version }}" "%TEMP%\crsh-out.txt" >nul
            if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
            exit /b 0

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/ccache/ccache-storage-redis
  summary: ccache Redis storage helper (Go)
  description: |
    ccache-storage-redis is a ccache remote storage helper for Redis,
    implemented in Go. ccache invokes it for redis://, rediss://, and
    redis+unix: URLs.
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - src/LICENSE
    - library_licenses/
  repository: https://github.com/ccache/ccache-storage-redis

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - faceprint
